# 3D Life — Mauritius Issei

> Markdown (GEO/AEO) version of <https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/life3d>. Author: **Mauricio Yokoyama Issei** · en-BR · Published: 2026-01-22 · Updated: 2026-06-21.

## Experience

Immersive and contemplative 3D journey through the history and memories of Maurício Issei, from 1982 to today, traveled with WASD, arrow keys or touch. Ends with a question to the visitor — "What is your next level?" — and offers [2D version in pixel art](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/life). The content is visual and generated in the browser; the same story, in text, is in [Evolutionary Terminal](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/terminal-evolutivo.md).
